decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting lies far from the firm's core knowledge, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the product, but it extends the firm's maritime competence and naval contracts tend to be long-term, so it is kept for now.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's certified engineering and testing base, and the new LED replacement kit shows the firm is actively assimilating and applying knowledge to this line.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the established offer and draws on existing design and LED know-how, though it is a relaunch of an older design with some risk of being phased out.
The pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core professional lighting knowledge, so it is easy to learn from and improve through in-house R&D.
The premium pendant luminaire builds closely on existing competencies and fits the firm's push toward energy-efficient LED solutions, making it well supported by its absorptive capacity.
